fullText.simplified:
决定

    三年过去了。
    大河东去，河两边的江东和荆州都很安静，这三年过得很快。
    孙策马上就二十岁了。过去的三年里，很多东西都变了。江东很大，有很多城市，其他城市里的一些人也有军队。孙坚死后，那些人慢慢有了新想法，他们都想做江东的主人，江东开始变得不安静。
    孙策太年轻，军队也很少，在不安静的江东，他就像大河上的小船，每天都过得很小心。河那边的刘表越来越好，军队也越来越多。如果哪天他打到江东来，孙策就危险了。
    北方的元树给孙策写了很多信。元树要孙策去他那儿，他希望孙策为他工作。孙策一直没有做决定，因为他不想离开江东，但是最近他觉得他要做决定了。
    最近，孙策的叔叔被一个人打了。那个人有一些军队，也想做江东的主人，打完孙策的叔叔，他还想打孙策。孙策的妈妈很担心，她拉着孙策的手说：“我知道你不想离开江东，我也不想。但是现在没办法，如果还不走，大家都会有危险。”
    妈妈的话孙策都懂。孙策还知道，打他叔叔的人不是最危险的，最危险的人是刘表。如果刘表打到江东来，他和他的家人们就真的会死。自己死没有关系，家人们不能死，他要保护他们。
    现在，孙策面前只有一条路，这条路就是去元树那儿。如果孙策为元树工作，那他就是元树的人了。刘表不敢打元树的人，孙策和家人们就都安全了。
    孙策做了决定。他把妈妈、弟弟、叔叔和其他家人们，送到了一个叫“曲阿”的城市。曲阿也在江东，但离荆州很远，刘表不会找到他们。然后，孙策带着助手和最后的一点儿军队去了元树那儿。
    离开的那天，天气很不好。孙策骑在马上，最后回头看了看江东，心想：“江东，再见！我孙策会再回来的！”然后他们就往北方去了。
fullText.traditional:
決定

    三年過去了。
    大河東去，河兩邊的江東和荊州都很安靜，這三年過得很快。
    孫策馬上就二十歲了。過去的三年裡，很多東西都變了。江東很大，有很多城市，其他城市裡的一些人也有軍隊。孫堅死後，那些人慢慢有了新想法，他們都想做江東的主人，江東開始變得不安靜。
    孫策太年輕，軍隊也很少，在不安靜的江東，他就像大河上的小船，每天都過得很小心。河那邊的劉表越來越好，軍隊也越來越多。如果哪天他打到江東來，孫策就危險了。
    北方的元樹給孫策寫了很多信。元樹要孫策去他那兒，他希望孫策為他工作。孫策一直沒有做決定，因為他不想離開江東，但是最近他覺得他要做決定了。
    最近，孫策的叔叔被一個人打了。那個人有一些軍隊，也想做江東的主人，打完孫策的叔叔，他還想打孫策。孫策的媽媽很擔心，她拉著孫策的手說：“我知道你不想離開江東，我也不想。但是現在沒辦法，如果還不走，大家都會有危險。”
    媽媽的話孫策都懂。孫策還知道，打他叔叔的人不是最危險的，最危險的人是劉表。如果劉表打到江東來，他和他的家人們就真的會死。自己死沒有關係，家人們不能死，他要保護他們。
    現在，孫策面前只有一條路，這條路就是去元樹那兒。如果孫策為元樹工作，那他就是元樹的人了。劉表不敢打元樹的人，孫策和家人們就都安全了。
    孫策做了決定。他把媽媽、弟弟、叔叔和其他家人們，送到了一個叫“曲阿”的城市。曲阿也在江東，但離荊州很遠，劉表不會找到他們。然後，孫策帶著助手和最後的一點兒軍隊去了元樹那兒。
    離開的那天，天氣很不好。孫策騎在馬上，最後回頭看了看江東，心想：“江東，再見！我孫策會再回來的！”然後他們就往北方去了。

sentences.simplified: 三年过去了。
sentences.traditional: 三年過去了。
sentences.pinyin: sān nián guò qù le
sentences.english: Three years passed.

sentences.simplified: 大河东去，河两边的江东和荆州都很安静，
sentences.traditional: 大河東去，河兩邊的江東和荊州都很安靜，
sentences.pinyin: dà hé dōng qù hé liǎng biān de jiāng dōng hé jīng zhōu dōu hěn ān jìng
sentences.english: Things had settled, and Jiangdong and Jingzhou on either side of the river were both very quiet.

sentences.simplified: 这三年过得很快。
sentences.traditional: 這三年過得很快。
sentences.pinyin: zhè sān nián guò de hěn kuài
sentences.english: These three years had passed by quickly.

sentences.simplified: 孙策马上就二十岁了。过去的三年里，很多东西都变了。
sentences.traditional: 孫策馬上就二十歲了。過去的三年裡，很多東西都變了。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè mǎ shàng jiù èr shí suì le guò qù de sān nián lǐ hěn duō dōng xi dōu biàn le
sentences.english: Sun Ce was about to turn 20. A lot had changed in the past three years.

sentences.simplified: 江东很大，有很多城市，其他城市里的一些人也有军队。
sentences.traditional: 江東很大，有很多城市，其他城市裡的一些人也有軍隊。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng hěn dà yǒu hěn duō chéng shì qí tā chéng shì lǐ de yì xiē rén yě yǒu jūn duì
sentences.english: Jiangdong was very big and had many cities. Some people in the other cities had troops.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚死后，那些人慢慢有了新想法，
sentences.traditional: 孫堅死後，那些人慢慢有了新想法，
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān sǐ hòu nà xiē rén màn man yǒu le xīn xiǎng fǎ
sentences.english: After the death of Sun Jian, those people slowly developed new ideas.

sentences.simplified: 他们都想做江东的主人，江东开始变得不安静。
sentences.traditional: 他們都想做江東的主人，江東開始變得不安靜。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dōu xiǎng zuò jiāng dōng de zhǔ rén jiāng dōng kāi shǐ biàn de bù ān jìng
sentences.english: They all wanted to become the master of Jiangdong, and Jiangdong started to become restless.

sentences.simplified: 孙策太年轻，军队也很少，
sentences.traditional: 孫策太年輕，軍隊也很少，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè tài nián qīng jūn duì yě hěn shǎo
sentences.english: Sun Ce was too young, and his troops were few.

sentences.simplified: 在不安静的江东，他就像大河上的小船，每天都过得很小心。
sentences.traditional: 在不安靜的江東，他就像大河上的小船，每天都過得很小心。
sentences.pinyin: zài bù ān jìng de jiāng dōng tā jiù xiàng dà hé shang de xiǎo chuán měi tiān dōu guò de hěn xiǎo xīn
sentences.english: In a restless Jiangdong, he was like a small boat in a big river. He was living very cautiously every day.

sentences.simplified: 河那边的刘表越来越好，军队也越来越多。
sentences.traditional: 河那邊的劉表越來越好，軍隊也越來越多。
sentences.pinyin: hé nà bian de liú biǎo yuè lái yuè hǎo jūn duì yě yuè lái yuè duō
sentences.english: On the other side of the river, Liu Biao was getting stronger and stronger, and he had more and more troops.

sentences.simplified: 如果哪天他打到江东来，孙策就危险了。
sentences.traditional: 如果哪天他打到江東來，孫策就危險了。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǎ tiān tā dǎ dào jiāng dōng lái sūn cè jiù wēi xiǎn le
sentences.english: If one day he came to fight Jiangdong, Sun Ce would be in danger.

sentences.simplified: 北方的元树给孙策写了很多信。
sentences.traditional: 北方的元樹給孫策寫了很多信。
sentences.pinyin: běi fāng de yuán shù gěi sūn cè xiě le hěn duō xìn
sentences.english: Yuan Shu from the north wrote many letters to Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 元树要孙策去他那儿，他希望孙策为他工作。
sentences.traditional: 元樹要孫策去他那兒，他希望孫策為他工作。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shù yào sūn cè qù tā nà'r tā xī wàng sūn cè wèi tā gōng zuò
sentences.english: Yuan Shu wanted Sun Ce to go over to him. He wanted Sun Ce to work for him.

sentences.simplified: 孙策一直没有做决定，因为他不想离开江东，
sentences.traditional: 孫策一直沒有做決定，因為他不想離開江東，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè yì zhí méi yǒu zuò jué dìng yīn wèi tā bù xiǎng lí kāi jiāng dōng
sentences.english: Sun Ce still hadn’t made a decision because he didn’t want to leave Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 但是最近他觉得他要做决定了。
sentences.traditional: 但是最近他覺得他要做決定了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zuì jìn tā jué de tā yào zuò jué dìng le
sentences.english: But recently, he had felt that he needed to make a decision.

sentences.simplified: 最近，孙策的叔叔被一个人打了。
sentences.traditional: 最近，孫策的叔叔被一個人打了。
sentences.pinyin: zuì jìn sūn cè de shū shu bèi yí ge rén dǎ le
sentences.english: Sun Ce’s uncle had recently been attacked by someone.

sentences.simplified: 那个人有一些军队，也想做江东的主人，
sentences.traditional: 那個人有一些軍隊，也想做江東的主人，
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén yǒu yì xiē jūn duì yě xiǎng zuò jiāng dōng de zhǔ rén
sentences.english: That person had some troops and also wanted to become the master of Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 打完孙策的叔叔，他还想打孙策。
sentences.traditional: 打完孫策的叔叔，他還想打孫策。
sentences.pinyin: dǎ wán sūn cè de shū shu tā hái xiǎng dǎ sūn cè
sentences.english: After fighting Sun Ce’s uncle, he also wanted to fight Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 孙策的妈妈很担心，她拉着孙策的手说：“我知道你不想离开江东，我也不想。
sentences.traditional: 孫策的媽媽很擔心，她拉著孫策的手說：“我知道你不想離開江東，我也不想。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè de mā ma hěn dān xīn tā lā zhe sūn cè de shǒu shuō wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù xiǎng lí kāi jiāng dōng wǒ yě bù xiǎng
sentences.english: Sun Ce’s mother was very worried. She took Sun Ce’s hand and said, “I know you don’t want to leave Jiangdong, and neither do I.

sentences.simplified: 但是现在没办法，如果还不走，大家都会有危险。”
sentences.traditional: 但是現在沒辦法，如果還不走，大家都會有危險。”
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì xiàn zài méi bàn fǎ rú guǒ hái bù zǒu dà jiā dōu huì yǒu wēi xiǎn
sentences.english: But now we have no choice. If we don’t leave, everyone will be in danger.”

sentences.simplified: 妈妈的话孙策都懂。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽的話孫策都懂。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma de huà sūn cè dōu dǒng
sentences.english: Sun Ce understood his mother’s words.

sentences.simplified: 孙策还知道，打他叔叔的人不是最危险的，最危险的人是刘表。
sentences.traditional: 孫策還知道，打他叔叔的人不是最危險的，最危險的人是劉表。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè hái zhī dào dǎ tā shū shu de rén bú shì zuì wēi xiǎn de zuì wēi xiǎn de rén shì liú biǎo
sentences.english: Sun Ce also knew that the man who fought his uncle was not the most dangerous. The most dangerous man was Liu Biao.

sentences.simplified: 如果刘表打到江东来，他和他的家人们就真的会死。
sentences.traditional: 如果劉表打到江東來，他和他的家人們就真的會死。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ liú biǎo dǎ dào jiāng dōng lái tā hé tā de jiā rén men jiù zhēn de huì sǐ
sentences.english: If Liu Biao came and fought Jiangdong, he and his family would really die.

sentences.simplified: 自己死没有关系，家人们不能死，他要保护他们。
sentences.traditional: 自己死沒有關係，家人們不能死，他要保護他們。
sentences.pinyin: zì jǐ sǐ méi yǒu guān xi jiā rén men bù néng sǐ tā yào bǎo hù tā men
sentences.english: It didn’t matter if he died, but his family could not die. He had to protect them.

sentences.simplified: 现在，孙策面前只有一条路，这条路就是去元树那儿。
sentences.traditional: 現在，孫策面前只有一條路，這條路就是去元樹那兒。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài sūn cè miàn qián zhǐ yǒu yì tiáo lù zhè tiáo lù jiù shì qù yuán shù nà'r
sentences.english: Now, Sun Ce only had one path in front of him, and that was to go to Yuan Shu’s place.

sentences.simplified: 如果孙策为元树工作，那他就是元树的人了。
sentences.traditional: 如果孫策為元樹工作，那他就是元樹的人了。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ sūn cè wèi yuán shù gōng zuò nà tā jiù shì yuán shù de rén le
sentences.english: If Sun Ce worked for Yuan Shu, then he would be Yuan Shu’s man.

sentences.simplified: 刘表不敢打元树的人，孙策和家人们就都安全了。
sentences.traditional: 劉表不敢打元樹的人，孫策和家人們就都安全了。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo bù gǎn dǎ yuán shù de rén sūn cè hé jiā rén men jiù dōu ān quán le
sentences.english: Liu Biao would not dare to fight Yuan Shu’s men, so Sun Ce and his family would be safe.

sentences.simplified: 孙策做了决定。他把妈妈、弟弟、叔叔和其他家人们，送到了一个叫“曲阿”的城市。
sentences.traditional: 孫策做了決定。他把媽媽、弟弟、叔叔和其他家人們，送到了一個叫“曲阿”的城市。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè zuò le jué dìng tā bǎ mā ma dì di shū shu hé qí tā jiā rén men sòng dào le yí ge jiào qǔ ā de chéng shì
sentences.english: Sun Ce made the decision. He sent his mother, younger brother, uncle, and other family members to a city called “Qu’a”.

sentences.simplified: 曲阿也在江东，但离荆州很远，刘表不会找到他们。
sentences.traditional: 曲阿也在江東，但離荊州很遠，劉表不會找到他們。
sentences.pinyin: qǔ ā yě zài jiāng dōng dàn lí jīng zhōu hěn yuǎn liú biǎo bú huì zhǎo dào tā men
sentences.english: Qu’a was also in Jiangdong, but it was very far from Jingzhou. Liu Biao would not find them.

sentences.simplified: 然后，孙策带着助手和最后的一点儿军队去了元树那儿。
sentences.traditional: 然後，孫策帶著助手和最後的一點兒軍隊去了元樹那兒。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu sūn cè dài zhe zhù shǒu hé zuì hòu de yì diǎn'r jūn duì qù le yuán shù nà'r
sentences.english: Then, Sun Ce brought his assistants and last few troops over to Yuan Shu’s place.

sentences.simplified: 离开的那天，天气很不好。
sentences.traditional: 離開的那天，天氣很不好。
sentences.pinyin: lí kāi de nà tiān tiān qì hěn bù hǎo
sentences.english: On the day he left, the weather was bad.

sentences.simplified: 孙策骑在马上，最后回头看了看江东，心想：“江东，再见！
sentences.traditional: 孫策騎在馬上，最後回頭看了看江東，心想：“江東，再見！
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè qí zài mǎ shang zuì hòu huí tóu kàn le kàn jiāng dōng xīn xiǎng jiāng dōng zài jiàn
sentences.english: Sun Ce rode on horseback. He looked at Jiangdong for the last time, thinking, “Jiangdong, goodbye for now!”

sentences.simplified: 我孙策会再回来的！”然后他们就往北方去了。
sentences.traditional: 我孫策會再回來的！”然後他們就往北方去了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ sūn cè huì zài huí lái de rán hòu tā men jiù wǎng běi fāng qù le
sentences.english: I, Sun Ce, will be back!” Then they headed north.

sentence_translations: Decisions
Three years passed.
Things had settled, and Jiangdong and Jingzhou on either side of the river were both very quiet.
These three years had passed by quickly.
Sun Ce was about to turn 20. A lot had changed in the past three years.
Jiangdong was very big and had many cities. Some people in the other cities had troops.
After the death of Sun Jian, those people slowly developed new ideas.
They all wanted to become the master of Jiangdong, and Jiangdong started to become restless.
Sun Ce was too young, and his troops were few.
In a restless Jiangdong, he was like a small boat in a big river. He was living very cautiously every day.
On the other side of the river, Liu Biao was getting stronger and stronger, and he had more and more troops.
If one day he came to fight Jiangdong, Sun Ce would be in danger.
Yuan Shu from the north wrote many letters to Sun Ce.
Yuan Shu wanted Sun Ce to go over to him. He wanted Sun Ce to work for him.
Sun Ce still hadn’t made a decision because he didn’t want to leave Jiangdong.
But recently, he had felt that he needed to make a decision.
Sun Ce’s uncle had recently been attacked by someone.
That person had some troops and also wanted to become the master of Jiangdong.
After fighting Sun Ce’s uncle, he also wanted to fight Sun Ce.
Sun Ce’s mother was very worried. She took Sun Ce’s hand and said, “I know you don’t want to leave Jiangdong, and neither do I.
But now we have no choice. If we don’t leave, everyone will be in danger.”
Sun Ce understood his mother’s words.
Sun Ce also knew that the man who fought his uncle was not the most dangerous. The most dangerous man was Liu Biao.
If Liu Biao came and fought Jiangdong, he and his family would really die.
It didn’t matter if he died, but his family could not die. He had to protect them.
Now, Sun Ce only had one path in front of him, and that was to go to Yuan Shu’s place.
If Sun Ce worked for Yuan Shu, then he would be Yuan Shu’s man.
Liu Biao would not dare to fight Yuan Shu’s men, so Sun Ce and his family would be safe.
Sun Ce made the decision. He sent his mother, younger brother, uncle, and other family members to a city called “Qu’a”.
Qu’a was also in Jiangdong, but it was very far from Jingzhou. Liu Biao would not find them.
Then, Sun Ce brought his assistants and last few troops over to Yuan Shu’s place.
On the day he left, the weather was bad.
Sun Ce rode on horseback. He looked at Jiangdong for the last time, thinking, “Jiangdong, goodbye for now!”
I, Sun Ce, will be back!” Then they headed north.
